_comment: Portable deny-list snippet for the python-uv-only module. Paste these entries into the `permissions.deny` array of a Python host repo's .claude/settings.json. It denies the commands that install or uninstall packages outside uv.lock (pip/pip3 install and uninstall, including `python -m pip`), the parallel managers (pipx, poetry, pdm) and the non-uv env builders (virtualenv, `python -m venv`). Read-only pip calls (`pip list`, `pip show`) stay allowed because they can't diverge an env from the lockfile; `uv pip` is uv's own interface and is not touched. A path-prefixed call such as `.venv/bin/pip install` is not matched, so the prose rule still carries that case. See the companion index.md for the rule.
